instructions.name: accept_admin_transfer
docs: Step 2: The nominated account accepts and becomes the new admin.
Only the exact `pending_admin` key may call this.

accounts.name: new_admin
docs: Must be the pending_admin nominated by `propose_admin_transfer`.

instructions.name: add_oracle_signer
docs: Add a signer to the multi-sig oracle

instructions.name: calculate_session_price
docs: Calculate dynamic price for a session

instructions.name: cast_governance_vote
docs: Cast an on-chain governance vote.  The voter signs the transaction
directly — the server cannot forge votes on their behalf.
`voting_power` remains in the instruction IDL for compatibility but is
**ignored**. Weight is fixed at 1 (one wallet = one vote) until a
stake/token CPI can prove voting power on-chain. Clients cannot inflate
yes/no totals by editing the unsigned transaction.

instructions.name: cast_jury_vote_onchain
docs: Cast an immutable jury vote.  The juror signs directly.

instructions.name: cast_vote
docs: Cast vote in jury dispute

instructions.name: claim_bandwidth_rewards
docs: Pay a provider's proportional Proof-of-Bandwidth mining reward for an epoch.
`provider_bytes_verified` is a claim about off-chain metering, so the program admin
(oracle) must sign to attest it, and one `EpochClaimReceipt` per provider per epoch
is created so the same provider cannot be paid twice. Before this, the provider
signed for itself and chose the byte count, so anyone could claim the whole pool.

accounts.name: epoch_claim
docs: One receipt per provider per epoch; `init` makes a second claim fail.

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Program admin attesting `provider_bytes_verified`; also pays the receipt's rent.

instructions.name: close_channel
docs: Close a state channel: oracle submits the final nonce + earned_lamports.
`earned_lamports` is paid to the provider; remainder refunded to buyer.
The channel PDA is closed (rent returned to oracle).

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Payer of the transaction fee.

instructions.name: close_escrow
docs: Close a terminal (settled/refunded) legacy escrow and return the rent
reserve to the buyer. Frees the buyer+seller PDA for re-initialization;
escrows settled after this upgrade close automatically on settle.

instructions.name: contribute_insurance
docs: Contribute to insurance pool

instructions.name: create_proposal
docs: Create an on-chain governance proposal.  Oracle pays rent, but the
proposer's wallet is recorded for accountability.

instructions.name: deactivate_listing_commitment
docs: Mark a listing commitment inactive (delist / supersede). Does not close the account.

instructions.name: deregister_gateway
docs: Deregister an edge gateway operator and return bonded stake to owner.

instructions.name: deregister_provider
docs: Mark a provider as inactive in the on-chain registry.
Called by the oracle when a provider deregisters or is removed.

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Oracle must be the current program admin.

instructions.name: emergency_pause
docs: Emergency pause - halts all operations

instructions.name: emergency_resume
docs: Resume operations after pause

instructions.name: execute_jury_verdict
docs: Execute jury verdict with rewards

instructions.name: execute_proposal
docs: Execute a passed governance proposal.  Only the admin can execute, and
the proposal must have status 1 (passed).  A minimum timelock of 24 hours
(172 800 slots @ ~400ms) after finalization is enforced.
Status transitions: 1 (passed) → 3 (executed).

instructions.name: execute_signer_rotation_proposal
docs: Execute a passed proposal to rotate a multisig oracle signer.

instructions.name: finalize_proposal
docs: Finalize a proposal once its end_slot has passed.  Permissionless —
anyone can call this.  Sets status to passed (1) or rejected (2).

instructions.name: gateway_heartbeat
docs: Submit periodic heartbeat and telemetry from a gateway operator.

instructions.name: initialize_deposit_vault
docs: Initialize the platform deposit vault PDA (seeds: ["deposit_vault"]).
Binds the sole hot-treasury withdraw destination and an oracle withdraw authority.
Users deposit via native SOL transfer to the vault address.

instructions.name: initialize_epoch_reward_pool
docs: Initialize an epoch reward emission pool.

instructions.name: initialize_escrow
docs: Initialize SOL escrow (legacy - single oracle)

instructions.name: initialize_escrow_multisig
docs: Initialize SOL escrow with multi-sig oracle

instructions.name: initialize_insurance_pool
docs: Initialize insurance pool

instructions.name: initialize_multisig_oracle
docs: Initialize multi-sig oracle configuration

instructions.name: initialize_price_oracle
docs: Initialize price oracle

instructions.name: initialize_program
docs: Initialize program state with emergency pause capability

instructions.name: initialize_session_escrow
docs: Initialize a funded session escrow PDA. Buyer pays rent + locks `amount` lamports.

instructions.name: initiate_jury_dispute
docs: Initiate decentralized jury dispute

accounts.name: initiator
docs: Program admin only. The initiator chooses the jurors, so letting a buyer or seller (or
anyone) call this let them seat their own jury and have it award them the escrow.

instructions.name: lock_session_commitment
docs: Lock session parameters on-chain at session creation time.
The edge gateway verifies bandwidth_limit_bytes against this PDA to
prevent server-side tampering of session limits mid-flight.

instructions.name: log_spending_event
docs: Emit an on-chain event for high-value spending operations.
Uses events (not persistent accounts) to keep cost minimal.
op_type: 0=withdraw, 1=p2p_transfer, 2=session_charge

instructions.name: multi_sig_pause_vote
docs: Pause the program once `multisig_oracle.threshold` distinct oracle signers have
signed this transaction. `oracle_signer` is one of them; every other approver passes
their wallet in `remaining_accounts`, where it must be a transaction signer.
`approvals` is kept so existing callers still serialize, but it is ignored: it is
instruction data, so listing another signer's public key proved nothing. Counting it
let a single oracle key pause the protocol by naming the rest of the set.

accounts.name: oracle_signer
docs: One oracle signer submitting their pause approval.

instructions.name: open_channel
docs: Open a state channel: buyer transfers `deposit_lamports` into the channel
PDA vault.  The oracle records buyer+provider pubkeys and the session UUID.

instructions.name: open_dispute_onchain
docs: Open a dispute on-chain.  The slot_seed (recent slot hash bytes as u64)
is used as a VRF seed for jury selection — the server cannot control it.

instructions.name: propose_admin_transfer
docs: Step 1: Current admin nominates a new admin.
The new key is stored in `pending_admin`; it takes effect only when
the nominee calls `accept_admin_transfer`.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Must be the current admin.

instructions.name: provider_heartbeat
docs: Update provider heartbeat and cumulative metrics.
Called by the oracle every heartbeat cycle.

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Oracle must be the current program admin.

instructions.name: register_gateway
docs: Register an edge gateway operator with bonded SOL stake.

instructions.name: register_listing_commitment
docs: Register a listing offer-hash commitment PDA.

instructions.name: register_provider
docs: Register a provider node in the on-chain registry.
Called by the oracle when a provider completes registration via the API.

instructions.name: remove_oracle_signer
docs: Remove a signer from the multi-sig oracle

instructions.name: settle_escrow
docs: Settle escrow (legacy). Program admin (oracle) only: the caller chooses
`bandwidth_used_gb`, so letting the buyer or the seller call it let the buyer
report zero usage for a full refund, or the seller report the full limit.

instructions.name: settle_escrow_multisig
docs: Settle escrow with multi-sig oracle verification

instructions.name: settle_escrow_mutual_receipt
docs: Settle escrow with a cryptographically mutual session receipt.
The transaction must include 2 preceding Ed25519SigVerify instructions:
- Preceding Ix 0: Buyer signature on `receipt:v1:{escrow}:{buyer}:{seller}:{bytes_used}:{sequence_num}`
- Preceding Ix 1: Seller signature on `receipt:v1:{escrow}:{buyer}:{seller}:{bytes_used}:{sequence_num}`
This allows buyer and seller to settle bandwidth usage trustlessly without an oracle.

instructions.name: settle_session_escrow
docs: Settle session escrow pro-rata by bytes_used. Oracle (program admin) only.
Seller receives billed share; buyer receives unused escrow + rent (account closed).

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Oracle must be the current program admin.

instructions.name: slash_gateway
docs: Slash a malicious or non-compliant gateway's bonded stake.

instructions.name: slash_provider_insurance
docs: Slash provider with insurance protection

instructions.name: stake_provider
docs: Stakes provider collateral on-chain using treasury/oracle custody.
The provider's internal DB balance is debited off-chain by control-api;
this instruction is the canonical on-chain lock of that collateral into
the provider stake PDA.

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Program admin (treasury custody) only: it funds the stake on the provider's behalf.

instructions.name: submit_review_attestation
docs: Submit an immutable review attestation for a completed order.
The rating_hash is SHA-256(rating || comment || review_id) — the plaintext
stays in the DB; the on-chain hash makes it tamper-evident.

accounts.name: program_state
docs: Appended last so the account order of existing callers is unchanged; they must add it.

instructions.name: submit_usage_proof
docs: Anchor a bandwidth usage proof on-chain for a specific escrow window.
Called by the oracle when:
- A 15-minute metering batch accumulates signed proofs, OR
- A session is terminated (bandwidth exhausted or user-initiated).
The instruction is idempotent in effect: submitting the same (escrow,
proof_index) twice will fail at PDA init (account already exists),
preventing double-counting.

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Oracle/admin pays for the PDA rent. Bound to program_state.admin (BC-05).

accounts.name: escrow
docs: The escrow PDA this proof belongs to.  Accepted as unchecked AccountInfo
so both the legacy and multi-sig escrow seed variants are valid.

accounts.name: usage_proof
docs: New immutable usage proof record.
Seeds: ["usage_proof", escrow_key, proof_index (u32 LE)]

instructions.name: submit_zk_batch
docs: `proof_hash`    — SHA-256 of the off-chain ZK proof blob.  Set to all-zeros
when no off-chain proof was attached. Non-zero means the
oracle attested it produced/verified that blob off-chain;
Solana does not yet verify Halo2 inside this instruction.

instructions.name: unstake_provider
docs: Unstakes provider collateral from the stake PDA back to treasury/oracle.

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Program admin (treasury custody) only: the withdrawn lamports are credited to this
account, which is the custody wallet. With any signer allowed, an attacker could
withdraw every provider's stake into their own wallet.

instructions.name: update_deposit_vault_hot
docs: Rotate the hot treasury binding on the deposit vault (admin/authority only).

instructions.name: update_prices
docs: Update market prices

instructions.name: update_program_config
docs: Initialize or update on-chain program configuration.
Requires multisig oracle to prevent single-point-of-control.

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Program admin only. This used to be any signer, so anyone could set
`unstake_cooldown_seconds` to 1 and the fee and limit fields to anything.

instructions.name: update_threshold
docs: Update signature threshold

instructions.name: withdraw_from_vault
docs: Withdraw SOL from the deposit vault to the bound hot treasury only.
Authority: vault.authority, vault.withdraw_authority, or program_state.admin.

instructions.name: write_admin_attestation
docs: Write an admin attestation PDA for a wallet.  Only the program admin
(program_state.admin) can call this.

instructions.name: write_kyc_attestation
docs: Write (or overwrite) an on-chain KYC attestation for a user wallet.
Only the oracle signer may call this.  The instruction is idempotent:
if an attestation already exists for the wallet it is updated in-place;
otherwise a new PDA is initialised (init_if_needed).
trust_tier: 0=new, 1=verified, 2=premium
kyc_status: 0=none, 1=pending, 2=approved, 3=rejected

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Oracle/admin pays for the PDA rent on first creation. Bound to
program_state.admin so arbitrary signers cannot forge KYC (BC-05).

accounts.name: attestation
docs: KYC attestation PDA.  Created on first call, updated on subsequent calls.
Seeds: ["kyc_attestation", wallet_pubkey]

errors.name: InvalidStatus
errors.msg: Invalid escrow status for this operation

errors.name: InvalidProposalPayload
errors.msg: Invalid proposal payload or hash mismatch

errors.name: SignerNotFound
errors.msg: Signer not found in the oracle signer list

errors.name: InvalidVaultDestination
errors.msg: Withdraw destination must equal vault hot treasury

errors.name: InvalidHotTreasury
errors.msg: Deposit vault hot treasury cannot be default pubkey

errors.name: OnchainGroth16Disabled
errors.msg: On-chain Groth16 batch submit is disabled (build without onchain-groth16)

errors.name: Groth16VerifierNotReady
errors.msg: Groth16 on-chain verifier not ready — refusing to write ZKBatchPDA

errors.name: Groth16InvalidProofAccount
errors.msg: Groth16 proof account must be 256 bytes (A||B||C)

errors.name: CalculationOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow or division by zero in payout calculation

types.name: DepositVault
docs: Platform deposit vault — holds inbound user SOL outside the hot EOA.
Users transfer SOL natively to this PDA; admin/oracle withdraws only to hot_treasury.
PDA seeds: ["deposit_vault"]

types.name: Dispute
docs: Dispute Account - tracks disputes on escrows

types.name: DisputeStatus
docs: Dispute status

types.name: EpochClaimReceipt
docs: One claim per provider per epoch. Created by `claim_bandwidth_rewards`; because it is an
`init` account, a second claim for the same epoch and provider fails.
PDA seeds: ["epoch_claim", epoch_id.to_le_bytes(), provider_wallet]

types.name: EpochRewardPool
docs: EpochRewardPool — On-chain bandwidth mining emission pool (Track 4.1).
PDA seeds: ["epoch-rewards", epoch_id.to_le_bytes()]

types.name: Escrow
docs: The Escrow Account PDA (for SOL)

types.name: EscrowStatus
docs: Escrow states

types.name: GatewayRegistry
docs: GatewayRegistry — On-chain registration, staking, and health for edge gateways.
PDA seeds: ["gateway-registry", gateway_pubkey.as_ref()]

types.name: InsurancePool
docs: Insurance Pool - Shared pool for provider protection

types.name: Jury
docs: Jury Account - Decentralized dispute resolution

types.name: ListingCommitment
docs: ListingCommitment — on-chain anchor of an off-chain Ed25519 listing offer hash.
PDA seeds: ["listing-commitment", provider_pubkey, offer_hash]
This is **not** a full on-chain catalog. Merchandising (title/media/search)
remains Postgres. The PDA only proves the offer hash was registered on-chain.

types.name: MultiSigOracle
docs: MultiSig Oracle Configuration

types.name: OracleSignature
docs: Oracle Signature Record - Prevents replay attacks

types.name: PriceOracle
docs: Dynamic Pricing Oracle - Stores current market rates

types.name: ProgramState
docs: Program State - Contains emergency pause and configuration

types.name: ProviderRegistry
docs: Provider Registry - On-chain provider information

types.name: SessionEscrow
docs: Funded prepaid session escrow (Phase 1b).
Holds locked SOL for PAYG/gateway sessions; oracle settles pro-rata by bytes used.
PDA seeds: ["session_escrow", session_id (16 bytes UUID)]

types.name: StakeAccount
docs: Stake Account - tracks provider's locked tokens for security

types.name: UsageProofRecord
docs: UsageProofRecord - Immutable on-chain record of a bandwidth usage period.
PDA seeds: ["usage_proof", escrow_pda, proof_index (u32 LE)]
A new record is created for each batched usage window.  Records are
append-only — once created they are never modified.  The escrow settlement
instruction (`settle_escrow_multisig`) reads the sum of all records for an
escrow to determine the final proportional payout.
